skill.name: ReasoningBank with AgentDB
skill.description: Implement ReasoningBank adaptive learning with AgentDB for agent memory, trajectory tracking, verdict judgment, memory distillation, and pattern retrieval.
skill.summary: Build adaptive agent memory and reasoning patterns with AgentDB-backed ReasoningBank.
skill.author: ruvnet

security_audit.summary: The skill is mainly documentation and examples. No prompt injection was found. Real risks come from unpinned npx commands, MCP registration, and hidden SQLite memory databases.

remediation.issue: Unpinned npx commands and MCP server registration
remediation.suggestion: Pin agentdb to a reviewed version, document the trust boundary, and require explicit user confirmation before MCP registration.
Document stored data, storage path, retention behavior, and cleanup steps. Allow users to choose a visible custom path.

remediation.issue: Migration and export can expose prior agent memories
remediation.suggestion: Warn users to review .swarm/memory.db and exported backups, sanitize sensitive records, and avoid committing backup files.

content.user_title: Build Adaptive Agent Memory with AgentDB
content.value_statement: Agents often lose useful lessons from prior tasks. This skill shows how to store, judge, retrieve, and distill reasoning patterns with AgentDB-backed ReasoningBank.
actual_capabilities: Shows CLI setup for an AgentDB-backed ReasoningBank database.
Demonstrates storing experiences, trajectories, and distilled patterns with embeddings.
Explains retrieval with reasoning, diversity, context synthesis, and memory optimization.
Covers migration from legacy ReasoningBank memory databases.
Provides export, import, statistics, migration, and troubleshooting command examples.
limitations: Requires Node.js 18 and compatible AgentDB or agentic-flow packages.
Does not provide production authentication, encryption, or retention policy guidance.
Example schemas and domains must be adapted before production use.
Several commands use agentdb@latest, so package behavior can change over time.

use_cases.title: Build Learning Agents
use_cases.description: Create agents that reuse past successful trajectories and improve decisions across repeated tasks.

use_cases.title: Migrate Reasoning Memory
use_cases.description: Move legacy ReasoningBank data into AgentDB while keeping existing workflows compatible.

use_cases.title: Prototype Experience Replay
use_cases.description: Test memory distillation, verdict judgment, and pattern retrieval for experimental agent systems.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Basic Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me set up ReasoningBank with AgentDB for a local learning agent. Include prerequisites, storage paths, and safety checks.

prompt_templates.title: Store a Trajectory
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a simple trajectory record for my agent task. Show what fields to capture and how to judge success.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Retrieval Quality
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my ReasoningBank retrieval strategy. Suggest domain structure, confidence thresholds, context synthesis, and memory optimization settings.

prompt_templates.title: Govern Production Memory
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production plan for AgentDB-backed agent memory. Include migration, export controls, retention, backups, and package pinning.

output_examples.input: Plan a ReasoningBank setup for a code optimization agent.
output: A setup checklist covering Node.js, AgentDB, database location, and MCP registration.
A memory schema for tasks, actions, outcomes, metrics, confidence, and reuse counts.
A safety note about local database storage and package version pinning.

output_examples.input: Improve retrieval quality for stored debugging experiences.
output: A domain taxonomy for debugging memories.
Recommended confidence thresholds and diversity settings.
A review process for pruning low-quality or stale experiences.

output_examples.input: Plan migration from a legacy memory database.
output_examples.output: A migration checklist with backup, validation, statistics review, and sensitive-data handling steps.

best_practices: Pin package versions before running setup, migration, or MCP commands.
Document what data is stored in each memory database before use.
Review exported memory files before sharing, committing, or uploading them.
anti_patterns: Do not run agentdb@latest commands in production without review.
Do not store secrets, credentials, or private prompts in reusable memory records.
Do not enable MCP integrations without understanding their permissions and runtime behavior.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps build adaptive agent memory with ReasoningBank patterns and AgentDB storage.

faq.question: Does it require AgentDB?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples assume AgentDB through the agentdb CLI or agentic-flow integration.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes a Claude Code MCP setup example for AgentDB.

faq.question: Is the memory database sensitive?
faq.answer: It can be sensitive because trajectories may include prompts, task details, and operational history.

faq.question: Can it migrate legacy ReasoningBank data?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes migration examples from a legacy .swarm memory database.

faq.question: Is this a complete production policy?
faq.answer: No. You still need access control, retention rules, backups, and package review.
